Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
The Camarilla Edition rulebook says, about Blood Hunt
referendums, "This referendum is not an action, so it
cannot be blocked, and action modifiers and reaction
cards cannot be played. Otherwise, this referendum is
handled just like any other." [6.5.6]

And, about referendums generally, "If a political action
is successful, the referendum is called. Some cards
from older sets use the phrase "during a political action"
to refer to the referendum part of the political action."
[6.3.2]

I'm not sure if this implies that all "during a political
action" non-action-modifier/reaction effects are now usable
during a blood hunt referendum or not. I guess it depends
on whether [6.3.2] means that those older cards are only
saying they're usable during the referendum part *of a
political action*, or if they're usable during any
referendum.

LSJ?

thanks,

Josh

hunted for blood

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Joshua Duffin wrote:
>
> The Camarilla Edition rulebook says, about Blood Hunt
> referendums, "This referendum is not an action, so it
> cannot be blocked, and action modifiers and reaction
> cards cannot be played. Otherwise, this referendum is
> handled just like any other." [6.5.6]
>
> And, about referendums generally, "If a political action
> is successful, the referendum is called. Some cards
> from older sets use the phrase "during a political action"
> to refer to the referendum part of the political action."
> [6.3.2]
>
> I'm not sure if this implies that all "during a political
> action" non-action-modifier/reaction effects are now usable
> during a blood hunt referendum or not.

It doesn't. It is the same phrasing as found in the FN and SW
rulebooks.

> I guess it depends
> on whether [6.3.2] means that those older cards are only
> saying they're usable during the referendum part *of a
> political action*, or if they're usable during any
> referendum.

It means what it says - the stuff that is restricted to "only
during a political action" is actually restricted to the

referendum part of the political action.
